chapter: Moten band, arranging and the guitar
title: Joining Moten: guitar and trombone, arranging from the start
summary: With Moten he alternated trombone and guitar, mostly soloing on guitar, and began arranging immediately; Basie came in about the same time.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: Listen, so when you get with Morton, do you play guitar or trombone mostly, there?
Yeah, with all the bands, one to another. We play one awhile, and if it's something I like, I'll switch to guitar in most of the arrangements.
I played mostly my solo work on guitar with Morton. Because we had a trombone player and I didn't see much to playing trombone.
No, but, now, do you start arranging as soon as you get with Morton or not?
Yeah, started right off, excuse me.
Yeah, I think we went in together, it seems like, or either he came right in after me. Or something like that. Yeah, he must have come in a little after me. That
information Ed Lewis remembers. He's got all that stuff. Yeah.
